name: Twin Grain
description: Strike with two hard grains packed into the knuckles of either hand in quick succession.

name: Mirrored Sand
description: Hold two matching banks of sand on either side of the body so a strike meets a bank first.

name: Sand Stride
description: Take a long stride on a ramp of sand that rises and falls under each foot in turn.

name: Dust Duet
description: Send two threads of dust in opposite directions and read the room from where each returns.

name: Paired Sandfall
description: Drop two falls of sand from either side of the foes so they close upon the middle.

name: Dust Fetters
description: Draw two cuffs of packed dust around the target's wrists and pull them to either side.

name: Grain Counter
description: Meet a strike with a sweep of grain that turns it to one side and answers from the other.

name: Paired Collapse
description: Gather two high dunes of sand at either hand and let both collapse onto the foes between.

name: Sand Pincer
description: Close two arms of packed sand on the target like a pincer and hold them tight.

name: Grinding Weight
description: Roll two vast dunes of sand together from either side until the meeting ground crushes all between.

name: Fallen Grain
description: Bring a fist down with the weight of falling grain gathered in the knuckles.

name: Sandfall Cloak
description: Let a fine fall of sand run down the body in a cloak that slows every blow.

name: Sandfall Step
description: Step out from beneath a falling curtain of sand and land lightly a pace away.

name: Sand Cascade
description: Pour a cascade of sand over a narrow front of foes so they stagger under the weight.

name: Sandfall Weight
description: Rest a heavy fall of sand on the target's shoulders until each step must be dragged.

name: Azure Dust Veil
description: Hang a blue-grey veil of dust over the field so foes lose the user in its color.

name: Burying Fall
description: Drop a wide fall of sand that buries the ground and everyone standing in its centre.

name: Sandfall Spear
description: Compress a column of falling sand into a spear that pierces a shield in a single drop.

name: Sandfall Cataract
description: Open the sky above the field and let a torrent of sand pour down until the ground vanishes beneath it.

name: Sandglass Palm
description: Strike with a palm where sand is poured narrow and hard through the wrist into the target.

name: Sandglass Guard
description: Hold a guard shaped like a glass whose neck narrows to turn a blow into a thin stream.

name: Pour Step
description: Pour the weight from one foot to the other along a thread of sand and slide ahead.

name: Neck Sense
description: Narrow a thread of sand to a point and read the force of whatever presses upon it.

name: Pouring Flick
description: Flick a hard thread of poured sand through a gap in the target's guard.

name: Sandglass Turn
description: Turn the body like an upturned glass so a blow pours off the shoulder.

name: Filling Glass
description: Pour sand about the target's legs in a tall glass shape and let it fill to the hips.

name: Narrowing Sand
description: Squeeze the sand around the target ever narrower until their movement is a thin trickle of effort.

name: Sandglass Burst
description: Break the glass of sand against the target so every poured grain lands as a single hammer.

name: Glass Funnel
description: Draw the foe into a funnel of sand that narrows round the body and pins every limb.

name: Glass Return
description: Open the body like a glass that takes a blow into its sand and pours it back as a rush of grains.

name: Wing Grain
description: Beat a winged hand across the target with grains riding the leading edge.

name: Wingdust Mantle
description: Fold a mantle of dust about the shoulders like the wings of a roosting hawk.

name: Dust Lift
description: Rise a body's length on a puff of dust and land lightly on the far side of the foe.

name: Dustwing Eye
description: Send a thin wing of dust overhead and read the field below from how it drifts.

name: Dustwing Beat
description: Beat great wings of dust once so a gust of grit knocks the foe off line.

name: Dustwing Talons
description: Rake the target with claws of dust that descend from above in two quick pairs.

name: Dustwing Screen
description: Sweep a screen of dust feathers across the front to turn a thrust aside.

name: Dust Raptor Dive
description: Rise in a plume of dust and plunge on the chosen foe with the whole height behind the blow.

name: Plume Rake
description: Rake a rising plume of dust across a group so each is cut and shoved to the ground.

name: Dustwing Flash
description: Vanish into a column of dust and strike from a point across the field in the same blink.

name: Flowing Grain
description: Strike with a stream of grain running down the arm and into the target as one smooth push.

name: Sandflow Guard
description: Let a slow flow of sand circle the body and carry off the force of anything that hits it.

name: Sandflow Step
description: Ride a flowing ribbon of sand under both feet to carry the body several paces on.

name: Sandflow Sense
description: Let the flow wash across the ground and read the shape of what stands in its path.

name: Sand Ripple
description: Send a ripple of grains along the ground that breaks against the target's ankles.

name: Carrying Sand
description: Sweep the footing out from under the foe and carry them a pace along the flow.

name: Sandflow Bind
description: Wind a flowing band of sand around the target's legs and tighten it with each pass.

name: Sand Wash
description: Wash a broad sheet of sand over a group of foes and strip their balance.

name: Sandflow Turn
description: Turn the flow around the body so a thrust is spun past the ribs.

name: Great Sandflow
description: Hold a mighty flow of sand running over the ground and drag every foe along with it.

name: Sand Undertow
description: Draw a deep undertow of sand beneath the foes and pull them down to the waist.

name: Sand Torrent
description: Let loose a river of sand across the whole field that sweeps away footing and binds whatever it passes.

name: Flat Sand
description: Slap a flat hand down with a sheet of dry sand riding it into the target's face.

name: Dry Guard
description: Spread dry sand over the forearms until it holds as dry and still as baked clay.

name: Sand Skid
description: Skid across a level sheet of sand and stop short of the foe's reach.

name: Dry Wear
description: Rub dry sand over a limb until fatigue sets in and the muscle slows.

name: Flat Sweep
description: Sweep a wide flat blade of sand across the ground at shin height.

name: Dry Binding
description: Dry sand packs round the target's stance and hardens until each joint is held.

name: Sand Sheet
description: Lay a vast sheet of sand over the field that scours the ground and all who stand on it.

name: Dust Needle
description: Thread a needle of compressed dust through a shield's weakest seam and into the body beyond.

name: Edgeless Grain
description: Wear at the target's very frame with sand no guard can turn until body and qi thin together.

name: Sworn Dust
description: Strike with a fist of dust bound by a vow to hit only the one it faces.

name: Oathdust Mantle
description: Pull oath-bound dust around the shoulders in a mantle that does not leave the user's side.

name: Oathdust Step
description: Step along a thread of sworn dust to the exact mark the user has named.

name: Oathdust Sense
description: Leave a pledge of dust at a doorway and know when anyone crosses it.

name: Binding Dust
description: Bind the target to their word with a ring of dust that tightens at each lie.

name: Oathdust Veil
description: Hang a veil of sworn dust before the foe so that it shows only what the user wills.

name: Oathdust Guard
description: Hold the line with a sweep of sworn dust that turns away any strike aimed across it.

name: Oathdust Ring
description: Raise a ring of sworn dust that scours every foe stepping across it until the vow is released.

name: Breaking Dust
description: Drive a spike of sworn dust through the guard of anyone who has broken their word.

name: Dust Seal Oath
description: Seal the target's qi circuits with dust sworn to hold until the user lifts the oath.

name: Windward Grain
description: Strike with a hand wrapped in grains driven toward the target by the user's own push.

name: Driven Grain
description: Drive a handful of grains forward at speed so they spatter the target's chest.

name: Grain Shell
description: Pack a shell of grains round the torso that sheds the first blow and holds shape.

name: Windward Skid
description: Skid with the push of the wind at the back and a wake of grains behind the heels.

name: Grain Gauge
description: Let the grains show the strength and direction of any push moving through the air.

name: Driven Dust
description: Drive a broad cloud of dust forward at speed to scour a front of foes.

name: Grain Turn
description: Turn the grains on the arm to roll a blow past the body.

name: Choking Grain
description: Blow a thick pinch of fine grain into the target's face until breath and balance falter.

name: Driven Lance
description: Drive a lance of packed grain ahead of a hard push to pierce guard and plate together.

name: Dust Whirl
description: Wind a roaring whirl of dust round the user that scours everything close to it.

name: Dust Passage
description: Dissolve the body into fine dust and pass through a gap no wider than a hand.

name: Mark Grain
description: Strike along a line drawn in the sand so the blow lands on the mark at its end.

name: Sand Plumb
description: Hang a plumb of sand from the guard hand that keeps the stance straight under any push.

name: Sand Heading
description: Step along a chosen heading in the sand and arrive exactly on the line.

name: Sand Compass
description: Let a pinch of sand settle toward the nearest hidden enemy and follow its lean.

name: Bearing Needle
description: Loose a needle of sand that travels the held line exactly to the target.

name: Held Dust
description: Hold the target in place with dust drawn tight along the same line.

name: Column Burst
description: Burst a column of sand straight down the held line through everything standing on it.

name: Sand Meridian
description: Trace the meridian lines with sand and press until the target's qi stalls on its way.

name: True Grain
description: Send a single grain along the held line that wounds the body whatever guard stands before it.

name: Open Dust
description: Strike with the palm open and dust flaring from it in a wide fan across the target.

name: Dustfall Mantle
description: Let a light dustfall settle over the shoulders until it layers into a loose mantle.

name: Open Skid
description: Skid over open ground on a bed of dust and stop wherever the user chooses.

name: Dustfall Sense
description: Read the dustfall on the ground and learn where it has been stirred by passing feet.

name: Dustfall Sweep
description: Sweep a falling sheet of dust across a row of foes and scour their faces.

name: Dustfall Press
description: Press a slow dustfall onto one foe until the weight stoops their back.

name: Dustfall Turn
description: Turn a blow aside through a shifting fall of dust that gives it nowhere to bite.

name: Dustfall Burial
description: Lower a heavy dustfall over the foe and bury them to the shoulders where they stand.

name: Wide Dustfall
description: Spread a dustfall wide enough that no foe in the field can step clear of it.

name: Unending Dustfall
description: Open a dustfall that does not stop and wears down every edge and guard it lands on.
